name: basket_spread_mean_reversion_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: A basket of 5 highly correlated private bank stocks (HDFCBANK, ICICIBANK, KOTAKBANK, AXISBANK, INDUSINDBK) tends to move together. When one stock's intraday return deviates by > 2 SD from the basket's average return, it reverts. This is a more robust version of pairs trading because the basket reduces idiosyncratic noise. The inefficiency exists due to asynchronous institutional order flow and ETF creation/redemption lags. Edge persists because basket construction and real-time monitoring is operationally complex.
stock_filter: HDFCBANK, ICICIBANK, KOTAKBANK, AXISBANK, INDUSINDBK — private bank basket

indicators.name: stock_zscore
indicators.purpose: how far this stock is from basket

long.confirmation: stock_zscore starts reverting (zscore[1] < zscore, turning up)

short.confirmation: stock_zscore starts reverting (zscore[1] > zscore, turning down)

exit.trailing_stop: move SL to breakeven when zscore crosses ±1.0

filters.time_filter: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.volume_filter: outlier stock must have normal volume (volume > 50% of 20-bar avg)
filters.event_filter: skip if any basket stock has results that day; skip on RBI policy day
other_filters: skip if basket_std_return_30 < 0.1 (no dispersion = no signal)

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — relative value in banks is structural but other quants trade this

weaknesses: Single-leg trade (not hedged against basket) so directional risk remains
Stock-specific news (e.g., NPA announcement for one bank) causes permanent divergence, not mean reversion
Only 5 stocks in the basket — limited trade frequency; maybe 1-2 signals per day
prior_art: Basket relative value trading — common on institutional stat arb desks. Indian private banks are a known pair group.
notes: Can expand to IT basket (TCS, INFY, WIPRO, HCLTECH, TECHM) or PSU bank basket for more signals.
